I added `apps/react-vite/e2e/tests/discussion-comments.spec.ts`. I did not run the test, lint or the app, as you asked.

The test follows the smoke test's steps and selectors:

1. Opens `/app` (the stored session from the setup project is reused), goes to Discussions and creates a discussion.
2. Opens it and adds two comments, each with its own "Comment Created" notification closed.
3. Checks the comments list holds exactly two items.
4. Deletes the first comment through its own list item, so the right comment is targeted when both have the same button label, and closes "Comment Deleted".
5. Checks that one item is left, that it contains the second comment's body, and that the first comment's body is hidden.

I did not add a cleanup step that deletes the discussion, unlike the smoke test. The smoke test asserts "No Entries Found" after deleting its own discussion, which only works because the mock database is per-context. This test should also start from the setup snapshot, which has no discussions, so I left cleanup out. If that isolation assumption is wrong, the smoke test's empty-list assertion could fail when run after this one.
